text:
Predicates:
PerformsInSchoolTalentShowOften(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
AttendsSchool(x) ::: x attends the school.
Engaged(x) ::: x is very engaged with school events.
InactiveDisinterested(x) ::: x is inactive and disinterested member of the community.
ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) ::: x chaperones high school dances.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WishesToFurtherAcademicCareers(x) ::: x wishes to further her academic careers and educational opportunities.
YoungChildOrTeenager(x) ::: x is a young child or teenager.
Bonnie(x) ::: x is Bonnie.
Premises:
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShowOften(x) → AttendsSchool(x) ∧ Engaged(x)) ::: If people perform in school talent shows often, then they attend and are very engaged with school events.
∀x (ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) → ¬AttendsSchool(x)) ::: If people chaperone high school dances, then they are not students who attend the school.
∀x (InactiveDisinterested(x) → ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x)) ::: All people who are inactive and disinterested members of their community chaperone high school dances.
∀x ((YoungChildOrTeenager(x) ∧ WishesToFurtherAcademicCareers(x)) → Student(x)) ::: All young children and teenagers who wish to further their academic careers and educational opportunities are students who attend the school.
Bonnie(x) ∧ ( (AttendsSchool(x) ∧ Engaged(x) ∧ Bonnie(x)) ∨ (¬AttendsSchool(x) ∧ ¬Engaged(x) ∧ Bonnie(x)) ) ::: Bonnie either both attends and is very engaged with school events and is a student who attends the school, or she neither attends and is very engaged nor is a student who attends the school.
Conclusion:
(ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(Bonnie) ∨ (¬ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(Bonnie))) → (YoungChildOrTeenager(Bonnie) ∧ WishesToFurtherAcademicCareers(Bonnie) ∧ InactiveDisinterested(Bonnie)) ::: If Bonnie either chaperones high school dances or, if she does not, she performs in school talent shows often, then Bonnie is both a young child or teenager who wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities and an inactive and disinterested member of the community.
